user.title: Taiwan CWA Weather
user.description:
Pick the zone to provide weather for. The nearest township forecast and observation station are chosen automatically from its coordinates.

Get a free API key at [{opendata_host}]({opendata_url}): register, then go to Member Center → API Key.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter API key
reauth_confirm.description: The Central Weather Administration rejected the current API key. Enter a new one.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the CWA API.
error.zone_not_found: The zone or its coordinates could not be found.
error.outside_taiwan: This zone is outside Taiwan; CWA has no forecast for it.

abort.reauth_successful: The API key has been updated.

init.title: Observation station
init.description:
Forecast location: {township}

Choose the station that provides live observations. Auto picks the nearest station at a similar altitude and falls back to a backup station when it has no data.
